meta.title: Toolkit (dsh-toolkit)
meta.description: Seven families, 15 tools: table diff (table_diff/table_peek), AST search plus literal rename with coverage checks, session logs, checkpoint snapshots, multi-threaded download, a bash executor, file access (encoding probe + revision CAS), and on-demand help. Every family is **off by default** — enable them in Settings → 工具集 (help stays on).
